SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch B.2. Section
Date September 12, 1932.

Subject (in full) Communist and Pro-communist literature found at No.7 Tsong
Sing Faung, Ward Road, September 7, 1932.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by J.B.M. 41

Nos.1, 2 and 3 as quoted on the attached list are
communistic. Here follows an outline of the contents of No.3.
Contains (1) an outline of the Constitution of the
Soviet Republic of China (2) the Labour law and Land Regulations
of the Soviet Government (3) Resolutions passed relating to the
Chinese Red Army (4) the Soviet economic policy (5) Resolutions
passed relating to a minority of certain peoples in China (such
as Mongolians, Thibetans, Mohamedans etc.)
The following is a review of Nos.4, 5 and 6 :-
Pro-Communistic. The character of these books is
mainly of a narrative and discursive nature touching on the
subjects of revolution, economics and materialism.
No.4. Eulogizes the economic and social policies of
Soviet Russia.
No.5. Deals with theories which consider the facts of the
universe to be explained by the existence and nature of matter.
No.6. Is a translation of a book entitled "Lenin
Kampfende matuelist" (Lenin - Struggling materialists)
written by a German author named A. Deborin - (Practically on the
same line as No.5 above.

(批：CCP)
(签名：W.B. Moore D.S.)

Officer i/c Special Branch.
(签名：J.B. (Brown))
(批：Information.)

来自 2
G. 10,000-6-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
特务科 B.2 股
日期：1932年9月12日。

主题（全称）：1932年9月7日在华德路宗兴坊7号查获的共产主义及亲共文献。

制作人：D.S. Moore。转呈人：J.B.M. 41

附件清单中所列第1、2和3项为共产主义性质。以下是第3项的内容概要。
包含 (1) 中华苏维埃共和国宪法大纲 (2) 苏维埃政府的劳动法与土地条例 (3) 关于中国红军的决议案 (4) 苏维埃经济政策 (5) 关于中国某些少数民族（如蒙古人、西藏人、穆斯林等）的决议案。
以下是对第4、5和6项的评述：
亲共性质。这些书籍的性质主要为叙述性和论述性，涉及革命、经济学和唯物主义等主题。
第4项。颂扬苏俄的经济和社会政策。
第5项。探讨认为宇宙事实可由物质的存在和性质来解释的理论。
第6项。是一本名为《Lenin Kampfende matuelist》（列宁——战斗的唯物主义者）的译著，作者为德国人 A. Deborin ——（实际上与上述第5项属同一路线）。

(批注：中共)
(签名：W.B. Moore D.S.)

特务科主管警官。
(签名：J.B. (Brown))
(批注：情报。)
副总监 D
(签名：J.K. Givens)
特务科主管
1932年9月12日。

(印章：犯罪科副总监 1932年9月12日)

(右上角印章及手写：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特务科登记处 档案号 4020 1932年9月17日)

List of Communist and pro-communist literature found
at No.7 Tsong Shing Faung (      ), Ward Road, at 5 a.m.
September 7, 1932.

1) "Red Flag" weekly, issue No.34, 1.4.32
   (communist publication)                                1 copy.

2) "Red Flag" weekly, issue No.35, 8.4.32                1 copy.

3) Booklet entitled "Laws and Ordinances
   of the Chinese Soviet Republic",                       1 copy.
   issued in December 1931.

4) Book entitled "Economic and Social Policies
   of Soviet Russia".                                     1 copy.

5) Book entitled "Dialectics on Materialism"              1 copy.

6) Book entitled "Dialectics or Science of
   Materialism".                                          1 copy.
